task: Cycle 2 biomolecular design: reversible RNA-switch rate acquisition and robust sequence ranking

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For a time-homogeneous U<->C<->B CTMC with rates U->C=alpha, C->U=beta, C->B=c*kon, B->C=koff, initialized in U, let S=alpha+beta+c*kon+koff, D=alpha*c*kon+alpha*koff+beta*koff, and r±=(S±sqrt(S^2-4D))/2. For c>0 and distinct roots, P(B at t)=alpha*c*kon/D * [1-(r+ exp(-r- t)-r- exp(-r+ t))/(r+-r-)]; repeated-root value is its continuous limit and at c=0 it is zero.
claims.status: conditional_theorem; exact finite-state model identity internally derived
claims.novelty_boundary: Closed-form CTMC calculations are standard, and reversible ligand/folding models in riboswitches are prior art; no novelty claim.
claims.costs: Needs calibrated sequence-specific alpha, beta, kon, koff, concentration c, and decision time t; constant-size closed-form evaluation after acquisition.
claims.falsifier: Non-exponential state dwell times, non-linear concentration dependence, additional bound or folding states, or history-dependent rates invalidate the three-state response interface.
claims.next_gate: Fit state-resolved dwell paths under fixed transcription conditions and validate the full response at a withheld dose/time.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For two U<->C<->B birth-death CTMCs initialized in the same ordered state, if alpha_A>=alpha_B, beta_A<=beta_B, kon_A>=kon_B, and koff_A<=koff_B, then P_A(B at t)>=P_B(B at t) for every common c>=0 and t>=0. The same result holds under a shared nonnegative time-varying ligand schedule c(t).
claims.status: conditional_theorem; internally reconstructed application of standard birth-death stochastic monotonicity
claims.novelty_boundary: The comparison argument is standard; this is a task-specific all-dose/all-time sequence-ranking consequence. Priority is unresolved.
claims.costs: Requires simultaneous rate intervals for each prespecified sequence; no reporter grid over dose and time is required after the model is acquired. Model validation assays and state-resolving trajectory acquisition remain necessary.
claims.falsifier: A held-out bound-state or regulatory response outside the interval prediction band under validated CTMC assumptions rejects use of the fitted model. A rate tradeoff alone does not falsify the theorem; it makes the candidates incomparable.
claims.next_gate: Test two to four same-aptamer expression-platform variants with state-resolved trajectories and a preregistered held-out decision condition.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For each of K frozen sequences at a fixed calibrated concentration c_star>0, observe m_U, m_C, and m_B independent complete dwell episodes. U and B sojourns have exponential rates alpha and koff. C sojourns have exponential total rate rho=beta+c_star*kon, with C->B exit probability r=c_star*kon/rho independent of duration. Exact chi-square intervals for exponential rates and a Clopper-Pearson interval for r, transformed via gamma=rho*r and beta=rho*(1-r), give simultaneous rate coverage >=1-delta by allocating eta=delta/(4K) to each of four primitive intervals per sequence. A pair is robustly ranked when its rate intervals are separated in the favorable componentwise order; otherwise the all-domain ranking is UNKNOWN.
claims.status: conditional_algorithm; exact fixed-look marginal intervals internally reconstructed from standard exponential/binomial inference
claims.novelty_boundary: The inference distributions and Bonferroni correction are standard; no claim of a new statistical method.
claims.costs: At a fixed look with m episodes per source state and K sequences, 3*K*m completed dwell episodes are required; expected planned dwell duration per sequence j is m/alpha_j + m/(beta_j+c_star*kon_j) + m/koff_j. Add construct synthesis/QC, state preparation, FRET calibration, camera frames, censoring losses, concentration calibration, and held-out output assays. Repeated optional looks require alpha spending.
claims.falsifier: Confidence coverage is not certified if dwell episodes are not independent exponential samples, exit labels are misclassified, data are censored without a valid likelihood, or concentration is miscalibrated.
claims.next_gate: Acquire a fixed-look pilot, evaluate dwell diagnostics and rate intervals, and report pairwise rank only after simultaneous separation.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: With alpha=beta=1 s^-1 for both candidates and c=1 micromolar, candidate A (kon=2 micromolar^-1 s^-1,koff=10 s^-1) has P_A(B_t)=t^2+O(t^3) and stationary bound probability 1/11; candidate B (kon=1 micromolar^-1 s^-1,koff=1 s^-1) has P_B(B_t)=t^2/2+O(t^3) and stationary bound probability 1/3. Their exact response curves cross near t=0.273165 s.
claims.status: exact_model_counterexample; numerical root is a finite computation from the closed form
claims.novelty_boundary: Synthetic counterexample demonstrating why tradeoff pairs cannot be totally ordered; it is not an empirical biological observation.
claims.costs: Constant-size evaluation and one-dimensional root solve; no wet-lab cost for the mathematical example.
claims.falsifier: The stated probabilities and crossing are directly checkable from the exact finite-state formula; no empirical claim is made.
claims.next_gate: Keep non-separated or tradeoff candidates incomparable globally, or choose using a prespecified concentration/time response objective.

work_boundaries.prior_art: Beisel-Smolke and Lin-Thirumalai provide primary reversible riboswitch kinetic models; Keilson-Kester establish birth-death monotonicity. The present report claims no novelty or priority.
unperformed: No single-molecule trajectory or reporter measurement was collected.
No external proof review, novelty search, or biological validation was completed.
